in_marathi.name: Gajaanan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ganesha's name, meaning 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Anan' (pride)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajaanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajaanan is a revered name derived from Lord Ganesha, who is known as the elephant-headed god. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the god of wisdom, knowledge, and new beginnings. The name 'Gajaanan' represents the strength and wisdom of the elephant and the pride of being a child of the divine.
